Title: How Many Bags of Concrete for a 10x10 Slab? (Free Calculator)
Description: A 10 x 10 ft patio slab 4 inches thick takes 33.33 cubic feet (1.23 cubic yards) of concrete: 62 bags of 80 lb mix or 82 bags of 60 lb mix with 10% extra for waste. Enter your own slab, round pad, or post holes to get cubic yards and bag counts. Free, no sign-up.

Title: Mulch Calculator: How Much Mulch for 200 Square Feet?
Description: Mulching 200 square feet of garden beds 3 inches deep takes 50 cubic feet, which is 1.85 cubic yards, 25 bags of 2 cu ft, or 17 bags of 3 cu ft. Enter your bed sizes, tree rings, and any old mulch already there to see how much to buy. Free, no sign-up.

Title: How Much Soil for a 4x8 Raised Bed? (Free Topsoil Calculator)
Description: A 4 x 8 ft raised bed filled 10 inches deep needs about 29 cubic feet of soil with 10% added for settling: 20 bags of 1.5 cu ft or 15 bags of 2 cu ft (1.09 cubic yards in bulk). Enter your own beds or lawn area to get cubic yards and bag counts. Free, no sign-up.

Title: How Many Tons of Gravel for a Driveway? (Free Gravel Calculator)
Description: A 12 x 50 ft gravel driveway 4 inches deep takes 7.41 cubic yards, about 10 tons at 1.35 tons per cubic yard. Weight per yard varies by stone, so the calculator lets you enter your supplier's figure. Get tons, cubic yards, and 50 lb bags for any driveway, path, or patio base. Free, no sign-up.

Title: How Much Paint for a 12x12 Room? (Free Paint Calculator)
Description: A 12 x 12 ft bedroom with 8 ft walls, one door, and two windows has 334 square feet of wall. Two coats at 350 sq ft per gallon is 1.91 gallons, so buy 2 gallons (3 if you paint the ceiling too). Enter your room, coats, and the coverage on your paint can. Free, no sign-up.

Title: How Much Concrete per Fence Post? (Free Concrete Calculator)
Description: A 10-inch post hole 3 feet deep holds 1.64 cubic feet: 3 bags of 80 lb concrete mix per post with 10% extra, or 30 bags for 10 posts. Enter your hole diameter, depth, and number of posts. The calculator also does slabs and round pads. Free, no sign-up.

Title: How Much Does a Cubic Yard of Mulch Cover?
Description: One cubic yard of mulch covers 162 square feet at 2 inches deep, 108 square feet at 3 inches, or 81 square feet at 4 inches. Enter your beds and tree rings to get cubic yards and bags, minus any old mulch already there. Free, no sign-up.
